proof_body:
by
  intro u c R hR hu hc
  have h : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicContOnCl u (Metric.ball c |R|) := by
    rw [abs_of_pos hR]
    exact ⟨hu, by rwa [closure_ball c hR.ne']⟩
  exact HarmonicContOnCl.circleAverage_eq h
target_source: ∀ (u : ℂ → ℝ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u (Metric.ball c R) → ContinuousOn u (Metric.closedBall c R) → Real.circleAverage u c R = u c
